answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. What survives to the falcon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A shale of per-task receipts records who did what, and the tundra of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
